name: custom-function-test-2824786169/assign-value-to-function-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Statements: Destructuring assignment statement — Only supports [`wildcard-binding-pattern`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#wildcard-binding-pattern)
reason: The whole negative case requires diagnostics for assigning to function identifiers through list, mapping, and error destructuring assignments. These essential non-wildcard destructuring patterns exceed the explicit wildcard-only support restriction, even though ordinary assignment and anonymous functions are supported.
unsupported_constructs: Mapping destructuring assignment {func : foo, id : n} = rec
Error destructuring assignment error(reason, func = foo, id = n) = testError
test_design_notes: The @error markers assert compile-time rejection; there are no @args, @panic, or @output assertions. The ordinary assignment negatives alone do not bring the entire case into scope.
